npcs.desc: A robed figure wreathed in faint storm-light, watching you with ancient, knowing eyes. The keep's last warden, or its ghost. Speak with him: |wtalk The Wizard = <your words>|n.

objects.desc: A small iron key, its bow etched with a single storm-rune that catches the dim light.
A banded iron chest half-buried in fallen masonry, its lockplate stamped with a storm-rune.

contains.desc: A heavy grey cloak that hums faintly, as though a sliver of the tempest is sewn into its hem.
An amulet of blackened silver, cold to the touch, its sigil worn almost smooth.

objects.desc: A pitch-soaked torch sputtering in a rusted bracket; it pulls free if you want it.
